Friend1 (18F) recently lost her dad to an accidental overdose. Her dad died the morning of a party our whole friend group was meant to attend. That's none of my business. A shit thing to do considering they're close but not my place, I was more preoccupied with trying to make sure Friend1 was ok so I didn't want to bring it up. Our friend then messaged on this chat asking Friend1 if she was still going to the party and if not could she give her any alcohol she had bought for it. I thought this was absolutely out of order and I messaged her privately and send quite strong messages. I said it was a really cunty thing to do ON the day her dad died. I called her pathetic and said she should be ashamed of herself. This happened last weekend. She left our groupchat. Went to the party and then came to school on Monday and dropped out. She had said repeatedly before that she was only in school this year to hang out with us. Friend1 is obviously currently preoccupied with famy stuff and not petty friend drama but she did tell Friend2 to fuck off as well. I spoke to her briefly about it before I messaged privately. I'm now being blamed by friends of Friend2 who were not in the groupchat for her leaving school. They are saying I helped bully her out of school. AITA? I'm beginning to think I was because of how strongly worded my message was.
